exampleSentences.cn: 他确实非常准确地描绘出了20世纪60年代乡村生活的真实风貌。
exampleSentences.en: He has caught the zeitgeist of life in the 1960s very well indeed.

englishDefinitions: the most successful point in the development of something
rootAffix: zen (看作ten， 十) + ith → 功力到了十层那真是功夫的顶点了 → 天顶； 顶点

englishDefinitions: a soft gentle wind

exampleSentences.cn: 现在，除了遥远的海浪以外，一片寂静，一阵微风摇曳着树林。
exampleSentences.en: There was silence now except for the distant sea, a slight zephyr stirring the trees.
